{{Quote|I trust you are going to enjoy your stay. We are most happy you have arrived at the best part of the season.|[[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]], to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="AotC-novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Beautiful Season''' was a [[storm season]] on the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="TIC" /> It was the equivalent of [[Autumn/Legends|autumn]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|60|Inside Attack of the Clones|Inside ''Attack of the Clones''}}</ref>

The Beautiful Season was a lengthy<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|tipocacity|Tipoca City}}</ref> [[Season/Legends|season]] characterized by violent [[Electrical storm/Legends|electrical storms]] and torrential rain.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|31|KAM 1-4|Kamino}}</ref> As [[Time/Legends|time]] went by following the [[Great Flood]], the turbulent weather of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] became less problematic for the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]], who learned to find beauty in this season. Visitors attempting to disembark on Kaminoan landing platforms during the Beautiful Season were not as well disposed towards the climate.<ref name="FF" /> 

When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went on a [[Mission to Kamino (Separatist Crisis)/Legends|mission]] to find the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] responsible for the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|plot]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] arrived on Kamino during the Beautiful Season.<ref name="TIC" />
